body.text:
Stūpa-lakṣaṇa-kārikā-vivecanaṃ
including
prakīrṇaka-caitya-lakṣaṇaṃ
body.translated_text: <s>Stūpalakṣaṇakārikāvivecana</s> (Examination of the Verses on the Characteristics of <s>Stūpas</s>), including the <s>Prakīrṇakacaityalakṣaṇa</s> (Characteristics of Miscellaneous <s>Caityas</s>)

body.text:
Ārya-Lokottaravādino yat kṛtir
Ācārya-bhadravyūhasya
body.translated_text: A composition of the noble <s>Lokottaravādins</s>, by <s>Ācārya Bhadravyūha</s>

children.translated_text: [Slkv p. 208]
<s>Siddham</s>! Homage to the <s>Buddha</s>!
[Slkv §1]
That which was taught in the <s>Prakīrṇakavinaya</s> (Miscellaneous Discipline) of the <s>Lokottaravādins</s>,
and that which is the <s>stūpalakṣaṇa</s> (characteristics of <s>stūpas</s>) [found] in the <s>sūtras</s> and elsewhere of other <s>nikāyas</s> (schools) — || 1 ||

body.text: darśitaṃ lokanāthena stokaṃ stokaṃ kvacit kvacit |

children.translated_text: [Slkv p. 209]
all that is set
forth
by <s>Bhadravyūha</s>. || 2 ||

body.translated_text: shown by the Lord of the World (<s>Lokanātha</s>), little by little, here and there —

children.translated_text: On an accessible piece of ground, where the site is pure and unoccupied,

children.text: na khabaddhaunnate snigdhe sthāne śucini kārayet || 3 ||
children.translated_text: on a place that is not waterlogged, [but] elevated, smooth, and clean, one should construct [the stūpa]. || 3 ||
A height of one <s>yojana</s> (league) has been prescribed; the circumference is half a <s>yojana</s>;
the railing (<s>vedikā</s>) is one <s>krośa</s> (quarter-league) in width — [thus] stated in the <s>Prakīrṇavinaya</s>. || 4 ||
The <s>stūpa</s> is declared to be as high as the circumference of the dome (<s>kumbha</s>);

children.text: tad aṃśena tu nemy ādi yāvad yaṣṭiśiraṃ kramāt || 5 ||
children.translated_text: and by its proportional parts (<s>aṃśa</s>), from the base-rim (<s>nemi</s>) upward to the top of the mast (<s>yaṣṭiśiras</s>), in sequence. || 5 ||

children.text: caturasrā bhaven nemir adhastātaḥ tad ardhena |
children.translated_text: The base-rim (<s>nemi</s>) should be square; beneath it, by half that
measurement of the casket (<s>karaṇḍa</s>), and also by a continuation thereof. || 6 ||
By one-eighth of the casket (<s>karaṇḍa</s>) [is determined] the plinth-course (<s>nimarjana</s>) below the base-rim,

children.text: udakodgamane yāvad ā śuddher cco bhuvaḥ smṛtāḥ || 7 ||
children.translated_text: [measured] down to the water-drain (<s>udakodgamana</s>); up to the purification [level] is reckoned [the height] from the ground. || 7 ||
Elevated by one-eighth [of the casket] — the base-rim is to be made to the [proper] measure;
circular or square — or otherwise, one should replicate [the form]. || 8 ||

children.text: tad ūrdhvaṃ vedikāḥ kāryāḥ catustridv'eka saṃkhyayā |
children.translated_text: Above that, the railings (<s>vedikās</s>) are to be made, in the number of four, three, two, or one,
with four corners or eight corners, or else circular. || 9 ||

children.text: sārccā gṛh'; ekasaṃyuktāṃ ūrdhvāṃ vediṃ prakalpayet |
children.translated_text: One should design the upper railing (<s>vedī</s>) with arched niches, joined together as one,
adorned all around the casket (<s>karaṇḍa</s>) with various decorative arts. || 10 ||
Then, in the four-cornered portion, in the measure of the middle cell (<s>koṣṭha</s>),

children.text: tisras teṣāṃ tu kartavyā caturthaṃ biṃba ba || 11 ||
children.translated_text: three of these are to be made, and the fourth [is for] the image. || 11 ||

body.text: Here the text breaks off, as folio 2a,b is missing. From the commentary, I am quoting the fragmentary pieces of the stanzas which were included in the text portion of folio 2a,b.
body.translated_text: [Here the text breaks off, as folio 2a,b is missing. From the commentary, the fragmentary pieces of the stanzas which were included in the text portion of folio 2a,b are quoted.]

body.text:
Slkv §2 adhaś caturthake bhāge ... [12] (§16.6a.2).
bāhyakoṣṭha ṣaḍ āyāmety ādi ... [13] (§17.6a.4-5).
tad anyānukramakṣīṇām iti ... [14] (§17.6a.7).

children.text: adho vedyā vistāras tad vedikāyā hrasve kṛtam | ... [15] (§18.6b.7).
children.translated_text: 'The width of the lower railing, the railing being made shorter...' [15].
'One should make [it] with an elevation,' etc. [16].
'The three railings — the shin-railing (<s>jaṃghāvedikā</s>) and the others' — is to be supplied. [17].
'The image should not project out,' etc. [18].
'Rising up in the casket (<s>karaṇḍaka</s>),' etc. [19].
[Slkv p. 210]

body.translated_text: [Slkv §2] 'In the lower fourth portion...' [12]. 'The outer cell, six in length,' etc. [13]. 'Of the others in that sequence, diminished,' etc. [14].

body.text: karaṇḍaś ca tatas tūrikām iti | [20] (§21.7a.7).
body.translated_text: 'The casket and then the finial (<s>tūrikā</s>),' [20].

body.text: aṇḍakaṃ vaṭayitavyam iti | [21] (§22.7b.l).
body.translated_text: 'The dome (<s>aṇḍaka</s>) is to be made round,' [21].

body.text: tasyādho bāhyakoṣṭhasyeti | [22] (§23.7b.2).
body.translated_text: 'Below that, of the outer cell,' [22].

body.text: tatpātrākāraṃ śāntikām iti | [22a] (§23.7b.3).
body.translated_text: 'In the shape of a bowl, the pacification [ornament] (<s>śāntikā</s>),' [22a].

body.text: sarvān manāsamaṃ somyam ity ādi | [23] (§23.7b.5).
body.translated_text: 'All equal in measure, pleasant,' etc. [23].

body.text: tad ūrdhvaṃ bāhyakoṣṭhasyety ādi | [24] (§25.8a.l).
body.translated_text: 'Above that, of the outer cell,' etc. [24].

body.text: pañcaviṃśatikoṣṭhakam ity ādi | [25] (§27.8a.45).
body.translated_text: 'Having twenty-five cells,' etc. [25].

children.translated_text: Four persons are recognized [as worthy of stūpas]:

children.text: arhanta cakravartis tu pratyekaś ca jino jinaḥ || 26 ||
children.translated_text: an <s>Arhat</s> (worthy one), a <s>Cakravartin</s> (universal monarch), a <s>Pratyekabuddha</s> (solitary awakened one), and a <s>Jina</s> (conqueror, i.e., a <s>Buddha</s>). || 26 ||

children.text: śaikṣāṇāṃ arhataś caiva gaṇakhaḍga jinasya ca |
children.translated_text: For <s>Śaikṣas</s> (learners), <s>Arhats</s>, <s>Gaṇa</s> (assemblage) and <s>Khaḍga</s> (rhinoceros-like, i.e., <s>Pratyekabuddhas</s>), and the <s>Jina</s> (conqueror) —
one additional [tier of parasols] should be made, adorned as a parasol-garland (<s>chatrāvalī</s>). || 27 ||
Endowed with relics (<s>dhātu</s>) of the body, [but] devoid of the <s>dharmadhātu</s> (element of the teaching) —
the <s>uṣṇīṣa</s> (cranial protuberance), moon, sun, pillars, and a pair of bells. || 28 ||
The inherent nature [of the stūpa], beginning with the cosmic age (<s>kalpa</s>) and the <s>Vedas</s>, should be explained for this <s>stūpa</s> —

children.text: adharā bhūmi pādāya yāvad ūrdhvaṃ krameṇa tu || 29 ||
children.translated_text: from the lower ground and base upward, in sequence. || 29 ||

body.text:
Slkv §3
1. dānaṃ pṛthivī
2. śīlan nemi
3. catvāry āryavaṃśā aṅgaṇāṃ
4. catvāry āryasatyāni sopānāni
5. vaiśāradyāni stambhāḥ
6. smṛtyupasthānāni adharā vedī
7. samyakprahāṇāni dvitīyā vedī

children.translated_text: [Slkv p. 211]

children.text:
8. ṛddhipādās tṛtīyā vedī
9. śraddhādīni paṃcendriyāni caturthī jaṃghāvedī
10. śraddhādīni pañcabalāni kaṇṭhakaṃ
11. anityādīni dharmamukhāni catasraḥ puṣpagrahaṇyāḥ
12. anāsravāḥ prathamadhyānabhūmijā prasrabdhisaṃbodhyaṅgaṃ kaṇṭhakaṃ
13. dvitīyatṛtīyadhyānabhūmijā prītiprīti saṃbodhyaṅgaṃ kaṇṭhakavalayaṃ valitakaṃ
14. anāgamyacaturthadhyānādibhūmijā upekṣāvedanā-upekṣāsaṃbodhyaṅgaṃ harmikā
15. smṛtidharmapravicayavīryasamādhisaṃbodhyaṅgāni catvāro lokapālāḥ
children.translated_text:
8. The <s>ṛddhipādas</s> (bases of supernatural power) are the third platform.
9. The five <s>indriyas</s> (faculties) beginning with <s>śraddhā</s> (faith) are the fourth leg-platform.
10. The five <s>balas</s> (powers) beginning with <s>śraddhā</s> (faith) are the neck-ring.
11. The <s>dharmamukhāni</s> (gateways of the Dharma) beginning with impermanence are the four flower-holders.
12. The undefiled <s>prasrabdhi-saṃbodhyaṅga</s> (awakening-factor of tranquility) born of the first <s>dhyāna</s> level is the neck-ring.
13. The <s>prīti-saṃbodhyaṅga</s> (awakening-factor of joy) born of the second and third <s>dhyāna</s> levels is the neck-ring garland and ring-molding.
14. The <s>upekṣā-vedanā-upekṣā-saṃbodhyaṅga</s> (awakening-factor of equanimity and equanimous feeling) born of the unattainable and fourth <s>dhyāna</s> levels and above is the <s>harmikā</s> (relic platform).
15. The awakening-factors of <s>smṛti</s> (mindfulness), <s>dharmapravicaya</s> (investigation of dharmas), <s>vīrya</s> (energy), and <s>samādhi</s> (concentration) are the four <s>Lokapālas</s> (World Guardians).
Slkv p. 212

body.translated_text: [Slkv §3] [Symbolic correspondences:] 1. <s>Dāna</s> (generosity) [corresponds to] the earth (<s>pṛthivī</s>). 2. <s>Śīla</s> (moral conduct) [corresponds to] the base-rim (<s>nemi</s>). 3. The four <s>āryavaṃśas</s> (noble lineages) [correspond to] the terraces (<s>aṅgaṇa</s>). 4. The four <s>āryasatyāni</s> (noble truths) [correspond to] the staircases (<s>sopāna</s>). 5. The <s>vaiśāradyas</s> (fearlessnesses) [correspond to] the pillars (<s>stambha</s>). 6. The <s>smṛtyupasthānāni</s> (foundations of mindfulness) [correspond to] the lower railing (<s>adharā vedī</s>). 7. The <s>samyakprahāṇāni</s> (right exertions) [correspond to] the second railing.

children.translated_text: 16. The Noble Eightfold Path is the mast.

children.text: 17. kṣīṇāsravabalāni trīṇi cāvenikāni smṛtyupasthānāni trayodaśa cchatravalyāḥ
children.translated_text: 17. The powers of one whose defilements are destroyed and the three unique <s>smṛtyupasthānas</s> (foundations of mindfulness) are the thirteen parasol rings.

children.text: 18. uṣṇīṣo mahākaruṇāviśuddhiḥ (Bénisti: tad upari anuttaramahākaruṇāviśuddhyā uṣṇīṣaṃ ||)
children.translated_text: 18. The <s>uṣṇīṣa</s> (cranial protuberance) is the purity of great compassion. (<s>Bénisti</s>: Above that, by the purity of unsurpassed great compassion, the <s>uṣṇīṣa</s>.)

body.text: 19. vimalā nirvāṇadhātuḥ sitātapatrā

children.translated_text: Slkv p. 213

children.text:
20. saṃvṛttisatyaṃ paramārthasatyaṃ candrasūryau
21. āryaratnam idaṃ gāthādvayam satvaviṣayātmagataṃ ghaṇṭādvayaṃ
22. sarvākārajñātājñānaṃ cchatraṃ
23. alobhātmikacetovimukti dhvajaṃ ity api sa bhagavān ity ādi
24. yaśas patākāḥ
children.translated_text:
20. Conventional truth and ultimate truth are the moon and sun.
21. The noble jewel — these two verses concerning the domain of beings and the self — are the two bells.
22. Knowledge of all aspects in all modes is the parasol.
23. The mental liberation whose nature is non-attachment is the banner. Thus "that Blessed One" and so forth.
24. Glory is the pennants.

body.translated_text: 19. The stainless <s>nirvāṇadhātu</s> (element of nirvana) is the white parasol.

body.text: prakīrṇakacaityalakṣanaṃ samāptam ||
body.translated_text: The miscellaneous <s>caitya</s> (shrine) characteristics section is concluded.

body.text: || āryalokottaravādino yat kṛtir ācārya bhadravyūhasya |
body.translated_text: By the noble <s>Lokottaravādins</s> (Transcendentalists), this is the work of teacher <s>Bhadravyūha</s>.

children.translated_text: Slkv p. 214
Slkv section 4
Having conquered all faults without remainder, having arrived at the far shore of qualities,
the victorious <s>Bhagavāns</s>, the <s>Tathāgatas</s>, who have conquered birth, are triumphant. (verse 1)

children.text: stūpaṃ kṛtvopadeśena yen'; artho jagataḥ kṛtaḥ |
children.translated_text: Having made a <s>stūpa</s> according to whose instruction the welfare of the world was accomplished,

children.text: tam ahaṃ śirasā vande bhadravyūhāhvayaṃ yatiṃ || 2 ||
children.translated_text: I bow my head to that ascetic called <s>Bhadravyūha</s>. (verse 2)
For the proper understanding of those whose minds are doubtful, ignorant, and confused,
an elucidation of the treatise on <s>stūpa</s> characteristics is here stated. (verse 3)

body.text: Slkv §5 prakīrṇam ity ādi | iṣṭadevatāyā namaskāraḥ sadācārānuvṛttaye | kim artham ācāryeṇa praṇāmārambhena kṛtaḥ | kṛto hy ācāryeṇa prakīrṇavinayasaṃgrahakārikādau namaskāraḥ | yasya vāco mano dehākhatulyāḥ sarvathā muneḥ || taṃ pranasyata sātatvaṃ vakṣye vinayakārikām iti || tad ekadeśa bhūtaṃ caidam ity anena nātrābhihitaṃ | ata eva prakīrṇavinaya ity ādinā tayavatām asya sūcayati śāstrakāra ity ato na doṣaḥ |
body.translated_text: Section 5: "Miscellaneous" and so forth. The salutation to the chosen deity is in accordance with good custom. For what purpose was the obeisance made at the beginning by the teacher? Indeed, the teacher made a salutation at the beginning of the Miscellaneous Vinaya Compendium Verses: "To that Sage whose speech, mind, and body are faultless in every way — bowing to him constantly, I shall speak the Vinaya verses." Since this is a portion of that work, it is not stated here separately. Therefore, the author indicates this very thing through the words "in the Miscellaneous Vinaya" and so forth — hence there is no fault.

body.text: Slkv §6 prakīrṇake hi yad viṃśatisahasrāyuṣiprajāyāṃ bhagavataḥ kāśyapasya kṛkina rājñā stūpaḥ kṛtaḥ yojanam uccatvena yojanaṃ pariṇāhena ardhayojana pratisareṇa krośamātrikayā vedikayā | tāmraloharaitikāya hastacāraṇāya tam upadarśayitvoktaṃ | sthale pradeśe stūpaṃ kartavyaṃ kārayatā prācīran ty evaṃ kartavyaṃ.
body.translated_text: Section 6: In the Miscellaneous section, when humanity had a lifespan of twenty thousand years, King <s>Kṛkin</s> made a <s>stūpa</s> for the Blessed <s>Kāśyapa</s>, one <s>yojana</s> in height, one <s>yojana</s> in circumference, half a <s>yojana</s> in extent, with a railing of one <s>krośa</s> in measure, with a copper-iron-brass handrail. Having shown that, it was stated: "A <s>stūpa</s> should be built on dry ground; one who has it built should make an enclosure wall" — thus it should be done.

body.text: Slkv §7 athāṅgana (MS: athāṅgaṇa) vedī jaṃghā puṣpagrahaṇīyaṃ | ā yakā aṇḍakaṃ kaṇṭhakaṃ kaṇṭhikā harmikā cchatrāvalī cchatraṃ ghaṇṭā dhvajaḥ patākā stūpagṛha āgama puṣkiriṇī prākāra coktaṃ | puna prakīrṇasaṃbandhe nedam uktaṃ | cakravartibhūtena mayā yojanam uccaṃ yojanābhiveṣañ ca stūpaṃ kṛtam

children.translated_text: Slkv p. 215

children.text: iti | tad anyeṣāṃ nikāyānām iti sarvāstivādināṃ stūpakalpanāsūtre kṣudrake coktaṃ |
children.translated_text: — that belongs to other schools. It is stated in the <s>Stūpakalpanāsūtra</s> and in the <s>Kṣudraka</s> of the <s>Sarvāstivādins</s>.

body.translated_text: Section 7: Then the courtyard, platform, leg, flower-holder, <s>āyaka</s> pillars, dome, neck-ring, neck-band, <s>harmikā</s> (relic platform), parasol row, parasol, bell, banner, pennant, <s>stūpa</s>-house, approach, lotus-pond, and enclosure wall — these were stated. Furthermore, in connection with the Miscellaneous section, this was not stated: "By me, who was a universal monarch, a <s>stūpa</s> was made one <s>yojana</s> high and one <s>yojana</s> in circumference"

body.text: Slkv §8 sagṛhastūpaḥ stambhaś catasraḥ pariṣaṇṇāḥ stambha sopāna lokapālā sthā sacandrasitāmbaraḥ patākā makaradhvajādayaḥ coktāḥ |
body.translated_text: Section 8: A <s>stūpa</s> with a house, a pillar, the four surrounding pillars, staircase, <s>Lokapālas</s> (World Guardians), base, with moon and white canopy, pennants, <s>Makara</s>-banners and others — these were stated.

body.text: Slkv §9 kūṭāgārasūtre coktaṃ | sarṣapaphalamātra dhātor arthāya āmalakamātraṃ stūpaṃ kārayet | tasmiṃ stūpe sūcīmātraṃ yaṣṭim āropayet | badarīpatramātraṃ cchatram āropayet |
body.translated_text: Section 9: In the <s>Kūṭāgārasūtra</s> it is stated: For the sake of a relic the size of a mustard seed, one should have a <s>stūpa</s> made the size of an <s>āmalaka</s> fruit. On that <s>stūpa</s>, one should erect a mast the size of a needle. One should place a parasol the size of a <s>badarī</s> (jujube) leaf.

body.text: Slkv §10 abhigamya iti | abhigamye praśaste bahujanopasaṃkramaṇīye na vā | vāstuśuddhe vāstuvidyāpraṇītalakṣaṇānvite | apratiṣṭhite anyacaityarahite | na khādi varjitonnate madhyonnate snigdhe arūkṣe śucini amedhyarahite || ity evaṃ stūpodgamapradeśaviśeṣaṃ nirdhāya lakṣaṇaṃ samupadarśayann āha | parinahena kumbhasyety ādi | parihaṇaṃ parināhaḥ pariṇāha | madhyabhāgaparikṣepaḥ paribandha yathāroha pariṇāhasaṃpannapuruṣa iti || tatra ca ārohaśabdenoccatvaṃ kathyate | na pariṇāhaśabdenoccatvaṃ | pariṇāhaśabdenābhidhānāt ||
body.translated_text: [<s>Slkv</s> §10] Regarding '<s>abhigamya</s>' (approachable): [the site should be] approachable, auspicious, frequented by many people — or not. The site (<s>vāstu</s>) should be pure, possessing the characteristics prescribed by the science of architecture (<s>vāstuvidyā</s>). [It should be] unoccupied — free from other <s>caityas</s>. Not sunken, not [excessively] elevated, elevated in the middle, smooth, not rough, clean, free from impurity. Having thus determined the specific characteristics of the site for raising a <s>stūpa</s>, he shows the measurement, saying '<s>pariṇahena kumbhasya</s>' (by the circumference of the dome) and so forth. <s>Pariṇaha</s> is <s>pariṇāha</s> (circumference) — the encirclement of the middle portion, the binding, as in 'a person endowed with circumference proportionate to height.' There, the word '<s>āroha</s>' denotes height; the word '<s>pariṇāha</s>' does not denote height, because it is expressed by the word '<s>pariṇāha</s>' [which means circumference].

body.text: Slkv §11 evam ihāpi pariṇāhaśabdena maṇḍalanābheś caturdiśaṃ | cakrāranyāyena madhyasūtraparikṣepaḥ paribandho 'bhiproktaḥ | caturthī pi kalaśādisthasaṃsthāneṣu tan mātraṃ pṛthutvasyāvyabhicārāt | kiṃ saṃbandhinā pariṇāhena kumbhasya kumbhuḥ karaṇḍaka tasya pariṇāhena stūpa dairgheṇeṣṭam ity arthaḥ | uktaṃ hi prakīrṇavinaye yojanam uccatvena yojanaṃ pariṇāheneti | caturasrā bhaven nemir ity ādi | caturasrā catuṣkoṇabhūmyāṃ kumbhaḥ karaṇḍaḥ maṇḍalānurūpyena nemivistāro bhavatīty arthaḥ |
body.translated_text: [<s>Slkv</s> §11] Likewise here too, by the word <s>pariṇāha</s> (circumference), from the center-point of the circle (<s>maṇḍalanābhi</s>) in the four directions, by the principle of the wheel-spoke (<s>cakrāra</s>), the circumference of the central line is intended. The fourth [measure] also, in the configurations of the <s>kalaśa</s> (finial) and other elements, is of that measure only, since the breadth does not deviate. What is the relation? By the circumference of the <s>kumbha</s> (dome), the <s>kumbha</s>, the <s>karaṇḍaka</s> (railing-box), by their circumference, the length of the <s>stūpa</s> is desired — this is the meaning. For it is said in the <s>Prakīrṇavinaya</s>: 'a <s>yojana</s> in height, a <s>yojana</s> in circumference.' 'The rim (<s>nemi</s>) should be square' and so forth — on a four-cornered ground, the <s>kumbha</s>, the <s>karaṇḍaka</s> — the extent of the rim (<s>nemi</s>) follows the form of the circle — this is the meaning.

body.text: Slkv §12 atra prakīrṇe coktaṃ | eṣa kaścit stūpaṃ kārayatā prācīrāntāt tāvat kārayitavyeti tad anukramārthaṃ cātra caturasrake maṇḍalasūtrapātād bāhyābāhyato madhyakoṣṭhaparikṣepo 'bhyantarataś ca | ekāsītikoṣṭhakanyāye sa vijñeyāṃ |

children.text: tato 'bhyantare ca nemibhittivistārārdhena draṣṭavyam iti | karaṇḍakasyāṣṭabhāgenety adi kumbhapariṇāhāṣṭamāṃsenādhastān nemyā nimarjanaṃ | udakodbhedaṃ vā yāvad āśuddher vā bhuvaḥ pṛthivyāḥ smṛtam ity arthaḥ | aṣṭabhāgonnatam ity ādi nemimānād aṣṭamāṃsam ādāya tenājitam unnataṃ kāryam ity arthaḥ |
children.translated_text: From there inside, one should see [a distance of] half the extent of the rim-wall (<s>nemibhitti</s>). 'With one-eighth of the <s>karaṇḍaka</s>' and so forth — below the rim (<s>nemi</s>), the leveling (<s>nimarjana</s>) [extends] by one-eighth of the <s>kumbha</s>'s (dome's) circumference. [This extends] up to the water-spring (<s>udakodbheda</s>), or up to the impure part of the ground, the earth — this is the meaning. 'Elevated by one-eighth' and so forth — taking one-eighth from the rim measurement, that much should be made elevated — this is the meaning.

body.translated_text: [<s>Slkv</s> §12] Here in the <s>Prakīrṇa</s> it is also said: someone who is having a <s>stūpa</s> built should have it built up to the extent of the enclosure wall (<s>prācīra</s>). For the purpose of that sequence, here in the square [base], from the circle-line outward on both outer sides, the circumference of the central compartment (<s>madhyakoṣṭha</s>), and from the inside — this should be understood according to the principle of eighty-one compartments.

body.text: Slkv §13 yataḥ prakīrṇake h'; uktaṃ | aṃgana na khasthala kāryam iti | vistāratas tv ayā vedikād bahiḥ kumbhapariṇāhapādenaiṣṭaṃ | catur asrikā medhī vedī jaṃghāpuṭāvedī kartavyeti |
body.translated_text: [<s>Slkv</s> §13] Because in the <s>Prakīrṇaka</s> it is said: the courtyard (<s>aṅgana</s>) should not be made level ground (<s>khasthala</s>). But in terms of width, from this <s>vedikā</s> (railing) outward, one-quarter of the <s>kumbha</s>'s circumference is desired. The <s>medhī</s> (platform), <s>vedī</s> (altar), <s>jaṅghāpuṭāvedī</s> (leg-panel railing) should be made square.

body.text: Slkv §14 sarvāstivādakānām āgameṣūktaṃ | catasra pariṣaṇṇāḥ kartavyā iti catus tri dv'; eka saṃkhyāyety anenena vedikābhisaṃbandhaḥ kriyate | catasraḥ parisaṇṇā kartavyāḥ | catvāri smṛtyupasthānāni prathamā vedī || yāvat paṃcendriyāṇi caturthī vedī | aneneva vinaye tatva uktā vedikānāṃ |
body.translated_text: [<s>Slkv</s> §14] In the <s>āgamas</s> of the <s>Sarvāstivādins</s> it is said: four enclosures (<s>pariṣaṇṇā</s>) should be made. With the numbers four, three, two, one — thus the connection with the <s>vedikās</s> (railings) is made. Four enclosures should be made. The first <s>vedikā</s> [represents] the four foundations of mindfulness (<s>smṛtyupasthāna</s>), up to the fourth <s>vedikā</s> [representing] the five faculties (<s>pañcendriya</s>). In this <s>Vinaya</s> itself the number of <s>vedikās</s> has been stated.

body.text: Slkv §15 katamaḥ saṃsthānābhisaṃbandhaḥ kriyate | tad āha ca catuṣkonāṣṭakoṇā vā athavā parimaṇḍaleti | sarvā gṛh'; ekasaṃyuktān ity ādinā | āyakapuṣpagrahāṇy āpekṣatāṃ | caturthī jaṃghāvedikāt kuryād ity artha | yataḥ prakīrṇake uktaṃ | caturdikṣu āyakāḥ kartavyāḥ | ayam eṣu buddhavigrahāḥ sthāpayitavyā | puṣpagrahaṇī kartavyeti | tatrāyakaśabdena pratipālakam ucyate | puṣpagrahaṇīśabdena na ca vedikābāhyata samantato vāpya paṃktyākāreṇa nānāsaṃsthānagṛhadvāramātre pūrvajātakapratimāṇāṃ racaneti ||
body.translated_text: [<s>Slkv</s> §15] What is the connection of shape made? He says: 'four-cornered, eight-cornered, or circular.' 'All houses connected as one' and so forth — with regard to the <s>āyaka</s> (projections) and <s>puṣpagraha</s> (flower-receptacles), from the fourth <s>jaṅghā</s>-<s>vedikā</s> one should make [them] — this is the meaning. Because in the <s>Prakīrṇaka</s> it is said: <s>āyakas</s> should be made in the four directions; <s>Buddha</s> images should be placed in these; flower-receptacles should be made. There, by the word <s>āyaka</s>, 'protector' is meant. By the word <s>puṣpagrahaṇī</s> — outside the <s>vedikā</s>, all around in rows of various shapes, at the door-openings of dwellings, images of previous birth stories (<s>jātaka</s>) should be arranged.

body.text: Slkv §16 adhaś catuskoṇake bhāgety ādi | harmikām upādāya yo 'dhaś caturthako

children.text: bāhyakoṣṭhāṃśas tatra dhānyarāśikṛtaḥ | sarveṇaiva caturthakena | tribhi pādaiḥ pātrākṛti | dvābhyāṃ pādābhyāṃ khagaṇḍākṛteḥ | pādaikena kalaśākārasyeti | madhyakoṣṭhapramāṇam iti madhyakoṣṭhapramāṇādya pramāṇagatenety ādi | etad uktaṃ bhavati | tatrāpi bhāgavibhāgena dhānyarāśy ākṛteḥ || madhyakoṣṭhapramāṇena tisro vedyaḥ kāryāḥ pariśiṣṭānāṃ tu yathā pratyanusāreneti | caturthī biṃbapaśyageti kumbhaparigrahānurodhenety arthaḥ | etad uktaṃ bhavati | adhaś caturthake bhāge kṛtānāṃ tisrāṇāṃ vedīnāṃ yāvantām apramāṇaṃ | caturthī jaṃghāvedī catuṣkoṣṭhāpi kumbhasaṃsthāneṣv ity arthaḥ | yathaḥ prakīrṇake uktaṃ | jaṃghāpuṭavedī kukṣitavyeti | jaṃghāyāḥ puṭavedī jaṃghāpuṭavedīti | jaṃghāsaṃbandhinī vā puṭāvedī kumbhasya padmavalitam ity arthaḥ |
children.translated_text: The portion of the outer compartment (<s>bāhyakoṣṭha</s>) — therein, [configured in] the grain-heap shape (<s>dhānyarāśikṛta</s>). With the entire fourth [portion]: three-quarters [correspond to] the bowl shape (<s>pātrākṛti</s>), two-quarters to the hemisphere shape (<s>khagaṇḍākṛti</s>), [and] one quarter to the pot shape (<s>kalaśākāra</s>). 'The measure of the middle compartment (<s>madhyakoṣṭha</s>)' means beginning with the measure of the middle compartment, [proceeding] by the stated measure, and so forth. This means the following: therein also, by division of parts, [following] the grain-heap shape — with the measure of the middle compartment, three platforms (<s>vedī</s>) are to be made; for the remaining ones, as per the successive order. The fourth [corresponds to] the view of the image (<s>biṃbapaśya</s>) — [this means] in accordance with the circumference of the dome (<s>kumbha</s>) — this is the meaning. This means the following: of the three platforms made in the lower fourth part, whatever their measure — the fourth, the leg-platform (<s>jaṃghāvedī</s>), even though [measured in] four compartments, [conforms to] the placement of the dome — this is the meaning. As stated in the <s>Prakīrṇaka</s>: 'The leg-niche-platform (<s>jaṃghāpuṭavedī</s>) should be [fitted to] the belly.' The niche-platform of the leg is the leg-niche-platform; or, the niche-platform connected to the leg [represents] the lotus-fold (<s>padmavalita</s>) of the dome — this is the meaning.

body.translated_text: [<s>Slkv</s> §16] 'In the lower square section' and so forth — below the <s>harmikā</s> (railing-enclosure at the top), the fourth [section]

body.text: Slkv §17 bāhyakoṣṭhaṣaḍāyāmety ādi | ṣaṇṇāṃ bāhyakoṣṭhānāṃ yo vistāras tad āyāmānāṃ tad dairghyām adhovedī kuryāt | atha bāhyakoṣṭhena vedikā ukteti ṣaṭsaṃkhyaparicchinna-āyāmo yasyā vedyaḥ sābāhyakoṣṭha ṣaḍāyāmamātrām adhovedīṃ kalpayet | yataḥ prakīrṇake yojanam uccasya krośamātrāvedīm ukteti | tad anyānukramakṣīṇām iti | adhovedyāyāmād upari vartinyaḥ tisro vedyaḥ | tāny anukrameṇa madhyakoṣṭhapramāṇena kuryāt | athavā catasraḥ pariṣaṇṇāḥ kartavyā iti vacanāt || merupariṣaṇḍavat | ardhardhonna

children.translated_text: -ing,

children.text: kṣīṇañ ca kalpayet | evaṃ tāvad bhūṅ gata stūpam ākhyāyādhunā bhūmimarjane stūpaṃ kṛtaṃ | bhuvas tu kalpanācalād evety arthaḥ | sthairyapuṣṭikaraṃ kila bhavatīti | ato bhūmyā nimarjanena kāraṇāyāyan darśayann āha | vetsyādiśu samaṃ | idan tu nimarjane nimarjanārthaṃ bhūmau stūpasya bhavatu unmānato kṣayo vedikānāṃ vistāras tu kim arthaṃ | stūpasyoccatvena samīkaraṇārthaṃ | yata stūpāyāmatulyo hy adho vedyā vistāra iṣyate |
children.translated_text: [each] diminished, one should fashion. Thus far, the stūpa placed on the ground has been described; now a stūpa made by ground-leveling [is described]. 'From the ground, by the technique of construction alone' — this is the meaning. 'Because it produces stability and nourishment,' they say. Therefore, showing the reason for the leveling by means of the earth, he says: 'In the willows and so forth, level.' But this, for the purpose of leveling — may the diminution of the stūpa on the ground be [measured] by height — but what is the purpose of the width of the platforms? For the purpose of equalizing with the height of the stūpa. Because the width of the lower platform is desired to be equal to the height of the stūpa.

body.translated_text: <s>Slkv</s> §17: 'The six outer compartments in extent,' etc. The width of the six outer compartments, that extent, that length — one should make the lower platform (<s>adhovedī</s>). Or, since the platform has been stated by means of the outer compartment — a platform whose extent is delimited by the number six — 'one should fashion the lower platform measuring six outer compartments in extent.' Because in the <s>Prakīrṇaka</s> it is stated: 'The platform of a <s>yojana</s>-height [stūpa] should be one <s>krośa</s>' — [the remaining platforms continue] diminishing by the successive order of the others. Above the extent of the lower platform, [there are] three revolving platforms (<s>vartinī vedī</s>); those should be made in succession with the measure of the middle compartment. Or, because of the statement 'four [platforms] all around should be made' — like the <s>Meru</s> circumambulation [terraces]. Half by half diminish-

body.text: Slkv §18 yathā hy uktaṃ mahāvastuni cakravartibhūtena mayā stūpo kṛto yojanoccatvena yojanam abhiniveśeneti | yatra hi yathā dhānyarāśyākṛteḥ kumbhasya yojanāni niveśya yojanābhiniveśo gamyate | tathā vedikāyā api tu kumbhapariṇāha pramāṇena stūpa uccābhipretaḥ | adhovedyā vistāras tad vedikāyā hrasve kṛtaṃ | kathaṃ pramāṇātikramaḥ | bhūvastukalpanābalān nemyāṅgaṇapramāṇasya pramāṇe 'ntaḥkaraṇād anatikramaḥ kalaśākṛteḥ | vedyunnāmasyālpatvāt nimarjanaṃm nākṣyaṃ |
body.translated_text: <s>Slkv</s> §18: As it is stated in the <s>Mahāvastu</s>: 'By me, who had become a <s>cakravartin</s> (universal monarch), a stūpa was made one <s>yojana</s> in height and one <s>yojana</s> in extent.' Where, as the grain-heap shape of the dome is set down [over] <s>yojana</s>-[units] and the <s>yojana</s>-extent is understood — so too for the platform, by the measure of the dome's circumference, the height of the stūpa is intended. The width of the lower platform — when made small relative to [the height of] the platform — how is the measure exceeded? By the force of the ground-construction, because the measure of the rim-courtyard (<s>nemyāṅgaṇa</s>) is included within the measure, [there is] no exceeding of the pot shape. Because the height of the platform is small, the leveling is not excessive.

body.text: Slkv §19 unnāmena tathā kuryād ity ādi | tad uktaṃ bhavati | harmikām upādāya yo 'dhaś caturthabāhyakoṣṭhāṃśas tasya yo vibhāgaḥ prākkṛtas tenaiva vibhāgenaikona tisro vedyaḥ jaṃghāvedikādyā ity āvyāhāryaṃ | na nirgacchet yathā biṃbam ity ādi |
body.translated_text: <s>Slkv</s> §19: 'One should make by means of height,' etc. This means the following: taking the <s>harmikā</s> (relic chamber at the top), the portion below that belongs to the fourth outer compartment — whatever division was previously made, by that very division, three platforms minus one, beginning with the leg-platform (<s>jaṃghāvedikā</s>), etc. — this is indisputable. 'The dome (<s>biṃba</s>) should not project,' etc.

body.text: Slkv §20 udakogamanena kṛtāyāṃ nemyāṃ | alpayāṃ vātha vasatyāṃ nemitaḥ | karaṇḍaṃ yathā nādhaḥ pratiset tathordhvāṃ vedīm unnatāṃ kuryāt | yato 'dhaḥ praviṣṭo nādhāya kalpate || karaṇḍakehy udgatety ādi | prādhyānyena ūrdhvavartinyāś caturthyā jaṃghāvedyā hrāsonnāmakaraṇenaiva kumbhasyodgamam adhomarjanañ ca saṃpadyate |
body.translated_text: <s>Slkv</s> §20: When the rim (<s>nemī</s>) has been made by the water-channel [line], or when the dwelling-space is small, from the rim — [make] the basket (<s>karaṇḍa</s>) such that it does not sink below; similarly, the upper platform should be made raised. Because [if] sunk below, it is not suitable as a support. 'From the basket, the emergence,' etc. — primarily, by the diminishing and raising of the fourth upper revolving platform, the leg-platform, the emergence of the dome and the leveling below are both accomplished.

children.text: Slkv §21 vedītrayasya connāmahrāso yataḥ tasmān nām'; adhoṃgaṇe ca kumbhe hrasvāt tato kuryād ity arthaḥ | yas tu paścād vakṣati | kumbhasyodgamanaṃ tat kumbhasya dṛśyabhāgamātram apekṣati | yatas tatra paramārthato vedyā hrasyonnāmamātropalabhyate | na kumbhasyodgamanam adho nimarjanaṃ veti | karaṇḍaś ca tatas tūrikām iti jaṃghāpuṭāvedyā upari dhānyarāśy ādi saṃsthāne na kumbhaṃ vartulaṃ kuryāt || yataḥ prakīrṇe uktaṃ |
children.translated_text: [Slkv §21] Since there is a diminution of height of the three <s>vedīs</s> (platforms), therefore one should make [it] with the reduced [height] at the lower <s>aṅgaṇa</s> (courtyard) and at the <s>kumbha</s> (dome) — this is the meaning. But what he will state later — 'the rising of the <s>kumbha</s>' — that refers only to the visible portion of the <s>kumbha</s>, since in reality only the slight rise of the <s>vedī</s> is perceived there, not the rising or the downward sinking of the <s>kumbha</s>. And [the verse] '<s>karaṇḍaś ca tatas tūrikām</s>' — above the <s>jaṅghā</s> (shaft), <s>puṭa</s> (recess), and <s>vedī</s>, one should not make the <s>kumbha</s> round, [but] in the form of a grain-heap (<s>dhānyarāśi</s>). Because in the <s>Prakīrṇaka</s> it is stated:

body.text: Slkv §22 aṇḍakaṃ vaṭayitavyam iti | navadhā vibhajitety ādi koṣṭhavibhāgakārikādvayaṃ sugamaṃ | bāhyakoṣṭhadvayonmānavedyāsanād udgato vartulārdhapauṣṭiko dhānyarāśisaṃsthāno na tu tribhāgocchritaḥ | śivasthalatvād iti ||
body.translated_text: [Slkv §22] 'The egg-shape (<s>aṇḍaka</s>) should be rounded.' The two verses on the division into compartments (<s>koṣṭhavibhāga</s>), beginning with 'divided into nine,' are easy to understand. Rising from the <s>vedī</s>-seat of the two outer compartments (<s>bāhyakoṣṭhadvaya</s>), it is a half-round full form in the shape of a grain-heap, but not rising to one-third [of the total height]. Because it is the place of <s>Śiva</s>.

body.text: Slkv §23 tasyādho bāhyakoṣṭhasyety ādi | tasya vartulārdhāṃśyo yo bāhyakoṣṭho 'rdhamānena | ardhabāhyakoṣṭhonmānavedyāsanād yan samutthitaḥ | tatpātrākāraṃ śāntikām iti | tato pī di | tasmād api pātrasaṃsthānāt | tenaivāntaroktapramāṇena bāhyakoṣṭhakonmānavedyāsanād yan samutthitaṃ | tad unnatikaraṃ khag'; aṇḍāsaṃsthānam iti | sarvonmānasamaṃ somyam ity ādi | abhiniveśamātraṃ apāsya yaḥ satvabhāvena īṣan samādhikabāhyakoṣṭhakordhvonmānāvedyāsanān samutthitaṃ | tadā puṣpakaraṇḍeṣu na kartavyetyādi |
body.translated_text: [Slkv §23] 'Below that, of the outer compartment' and so on. The outer compartment of that half-round portion — with half its measure, rising from the <s>vedī</s>-seat of half the outer compartment's height — that is the bowl-shaped (<s>pātrākāra</s>) <s>śāntikā</s> (peaceful form). Then the <s>pīḍī</s> (base): from that same bowl-shape, with the same previously stated measurement, rising from the <s>vedī</s>-seat of the outer compartment's height — that is the ascending egg-shaped (<s>khaggaṇḍā</s>) form. 'Equal in all its measurements, gentle' and so on — setting aside mere attachment, one who with a sincere disposition [constructs it] rising from the <s>vedī</s>-seat slightly above the outer compartment's upper height — then, regarding flower-baskets (<s>puṣpakaraṇḍa</s>), 'one should not make' and so on.

body.text: Slkv §24 na kevalaṃ bodhisatvānāṃ pratimā kumbhena kāryā kāṃcaneti buddhapratimā api | yataḥ prakīrṇake uktaṃ | lakṣam iti pratimālaṃkārair hi stūpam alaṃkartum iti | yatra hi pratimālaṃkārasyāpi pratiṣedhas tatra kathaṃ pratimāyā syāt | svayaṃ bhagavatā stūpapradakṣiṇī karuṇād iti ||
body.translated_text: [Slkv §24] Not only should images of <s>Bodhisattvas</s> be made with the <s>kumbha</s> in gold (<s>kāñcana</s>), but <s>Buddha</s> images also. Because in the <s>Prakīrṇaka</s> it is stated: '<s>Lakṣam</s>' means that the <s>stūpa</s> should be adorned with image-ornaments (<s>pratimālaṅkāra</s>). For where there is even a prohibition of image-ornament, how could there be an image [itself]? The <s>Bhagavān</s> himself circumambulated the <s>stūpa</s> out of compassion.

body.text: Slkv §25 tad ūrdhvaṃ bāhyakoṣṭhasyety ādi bāhyakoṣṭhasya bhāgatyāgonnāmataś caturthārdhaparityāgaḥ parigrahaḥ śeṣapādatrayasya cch (?) id unnāmas

children.translated_text: [Slkv p. 220]

children.text: tasya ṣaṭ kṛtvā ardhāṃśaṃ kumbhāntaḥ praviṣṭam āṃśadvayaṃ kaṇṭhakaṃ |
children.translated_text: of that, [divided] into six parts: the half-portion that has entered within the <s>kumbha</s>, and two portions [form] the <s>kaṇṭhaka</s> (neck);

body.translated_text: [Slkv §25] 'Above that, of the outer compartment' and so on. Of the outer compartment's proportional reduction in height: the abandonment of one-fourth, the retention of the remaining three-quarters, and the height [measurement]

body.text: Slkv §26 ekam āṃśakaṃ kaṇṭhikāvalitakāṃ harmikā yathākramaṃ | ekādaśabhāgavṛdhyā ardhāṃśavistārato vā | bāhyakoṣṭhavistārā harmikā tasyādhaḥ svonmānena samantataḥ kaṇṭhakaṃ || kṣīṇāṃ kuryāt | yathā śobhānurūpato vā anyathā kalpayed iti | se sākārikā sugamā |
body.translated_text: [Slkv §26] one portion [forms] the <s>kaṇṭhikāvalitakā</s> (neck-ring) and the <s>harmikā</s> (railing platform) in sequence, with increase by eleven parts, or from the half-portion's width. The <s>harmikā</s> has the width of the outer compartment; below it, the <s>kaṇṭhaka</s> all around with its own height. It should be made diminished, or arranged otherwise according to beauty. This verse with its commentary is easy to understand.

body.text: Slkv §27 pañcaviṃśatikoṣṭham ity ādi | pañcaviṃśatikoṣṭhavibhāgena yaṣṭer mūlamadhyaśirasā parigrahaṃ sugamo harmikāyā ūrdhvaṃ catuṣṭha pi kumbhasaṃsthāneṣu bāhyakoṣṭhadvayonmāno 'dhas va yāvat | hṛdayakoṣṭhapraveśo stūpaḥ | kalaśādisaṃsthāneṣu yathākrameṇa hṛdayakoṣṭhodgamāt | yathā yaṣṭer āyāmakṣayāṃ vā pariṇāhakṣayo vāpy avagantavyam ity evaṃ yāvat |
body.translated_text: [Slkv §27] 'Twenty-five compartments' and so on. By the division into twenty-five compartments, the retention of the base, middle, and top of the <s>yaṣṭi</s> (shaft) is easy to understand. Above the <s>harmikā</s>, in the four <s>kumbha</s>-shaped [forms], the height of two outer compartments [extends] downward as far as the entry into the heart-compartment (<s>hṛdayakoṣṭha</s>) of the <s>stūpa</s>. In the <s>kalaśa</s> (finial vase) and other forms, in sequence from the heart-compartment upward — thus one should understand that there is either diminution in the length of the shaft or diminution in circumference, and so on.

body.text: Slkv §28 stūpalakṣaṇaṃ pramāṇaṃ saṃsthānatas sunirdiṣṭam | yathā śobhata athoktalakṣaṇapramāṇānatikrameṇa saṃsthānataḥ prastākumbhākrāntyā || rajatamaṇikanakaśilādārumūrtikṛd iti | surabhipradeśe praśastāmanohare | svahastena vā karmahastena vā | tathā svabuddhyā vikalpa kāryaṃ | yataḥ proktaṃ yathā syā śobhano bhavet | tathā kuryād iti | āgamesmin iti | stūpalakṣaṇaśāstrasya vastumātropadarśanāt | yan mayoparjitaṃ puṇyaṃ tenāstu stūpas tu sugato jana iti ||
body.translated_text: [Slkv §28] The characteristics and proportions of the <s>stūpa</s> are well-defined according to form. According to beauty — that is, without transgressing the aforementioned characteristics and proportions, according to form, with the extension of the dome and <s>kumbha</s>. [The <s>stūpa</s> may be] made of silver, jewels, gold, stone, or wood. In a fragrant place, auspicious and pleasing. By one's own hand or by a craftsman's hand. Likewise, one should design by one's own wisdom. Because it is said: 'One should make it such that it would be beautiful.' In this scripture — since the <s>Stūpalakṣaṇa</s> treatise shows merely the substance [of the matter]. May the merit I have acquired lead to the <s>stūpa</s> [becoming a blessing for] the <s>Sugata</s>'s people.

body.text: stūpalakṣaṇakārikāyāṃ vivecanaṃ samāptaṃ || ||
body.translated_text: The commentary (<s>vivecana</s>) on the <s>Stūpalakṣaṇakārikā</s> is completed.

body.text: after this follows the Newārī note of a Nepalese librarian.
body.translated_text: After this follows the <s>Newārī</s> note of a Nepalese librarian.

body.text: Slkv §29 śrī syaṃguyāyita siyā jetanaku 35 aṃgu liḍā 5 yavanhasa 7 saaṃkanaghāva || ghātasaku 9 ku 5 ghalasaku 3 umaḍe thaṃthu ucaku 18 aṃ 5 yavanhana pramāneti madhyamādi kramena ||
body.translated_text: [Slkv §29] [Measurements in Prakrit/local script:] The <s>Śrī Syaṃgu</s> type (?): height 35 <s>aṅguli</s> (finger-breadths), width 5, height 7, with ornamental base; platform height 9, width 5, neck-band width 3, above the pillar height 18, [width] 5 — the measurements of the medium [stūpa] and others in sequence.

body.text:
On the top drawsheet, there are the following lines:
1 x x x x x pralase tīsijya pu manasīyā tachosathu se kho thu teya u(?)paritā na nesaṃ
2 ālayana || etad dharma x x x chela x x x x x || tad anantara draṃma (dharmma) likya
buna āleyana ||
body.translated_text: [On the top drawsheet, the following lines are found:] '... in those three... one should contemplate... that <s>dharma</s>-pillar... above them, not their abode. This <s>dharma</s>... cloth... After that, the <s>dharma</s> (teaching) should be written and inscribed.'

body.text:
stupalakṣaṇakārikāyāṃ vivecanaṃ vudja (?)
2 saṃvat
body.translated_text: [Colophon:] In the <s>Stūpalakṣaṇakārikā</s>, the <s>vivecana</s> (examination) [is completed]. Year (<s>saṃvat</s>)...
